hook: Weekly recap: who actually enforces Bitcoin's rules.

scenes.narration: Every full node validates blocks using the same consensus rules.
A block with an already-spent transaction is rejected.
Timestamps too far ahead, or older than the median of eleven blocks, are rejected too.

cta: Did you learn something? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Weekly Recap: Who Enforces Bitcoin's Rules?
description_body: Nodes reject double spends and bad timestamps. Miners don't set the rules.
